messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 3(17)

(17) ‘instructions for use’ means the information, provided by the manufacturer when the machinery or related product is placed on the market or put into service, to inform the user of the machinery or related product, of the intended and proper use of that machinery or related product, as well as information on any precautions to be taken when using or installing the machinery or related product, including information on the safety aspects, and on how to keep that machinery or related product safe, and to ensure that it remains fit for purpose during its entire lifetime;

response.text:
instructions for use | isProvidedBy | the manufacturer | when the machinery or related product is placed on the market or put into service | information, provided by the manufacturer when the machinery or related product is placed on the market or put into service
instructions for use | informsUserOf | intended and proper use of the machinery or related product | | to inform the user of the machinery or related product, of the intended and proper use of that machinery or related product
instructions for use | includesInformationOn | precautions to be taken when using or installing the machinery | | as well as information on any precautions to be taken when using or installing the machinery or related product
instructions for use | includesInformationOn | safety aspects | | including information on the safety aspects
instructions for use | includesInformationOn | how to keep the machinery or related product safe | | and on how to keep that machinery or related product safe
instructions for use | aimsToEnsure | the machinery remains fit for purpose during its entire lifetime | | to ensure that it remains fit for purpose during its entire lifetime
